prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make one entirely NEW wide 16:9 polished cinematic dimensional editorial illustration, 'When the Giants Stand', for ARC Daily. The user explicitly requests: 'Can the Giants stand up. While spidermen, turducken and other participants look up'. This is a new imaginative episode, NOT a reused composition or recolored existing picture. No text or scoreboard.
Input 1 ORIGINAL OWNER PHOTOGRAPH is absolute identity authority for exactly TWO rabbits: grey-brown lop with broad soft muzzle and BOTH ears flopped DOWN beside cheeks; companion dark charcoal-brown-and-white rabbit with BOTH dark ears UPRIGHT, dark eye patches, broad irregular WHITE forehead-to-nose blaze, white cheeks and chest. Input 2 is ONLY style, giant-scale and five fluffy black Tufa spider mascot reference; do NOT copy its setting, tram, crane, poses or machinery. Input 3 is ONLY the approved full Turducken crew and nested turkey/chicken/duck machine reference; do not copy flight composition.
Main action and framing: spectacular LOW-ANGLE from a snow-covered engineering assembly plaza in GPU Valley at early rosy sunrise. BOTH COLOSSAL rabbits are STANDING FULLY UPRIGHT ON THEIR HIND LEGS, full elongated torsos visible, small natural front paws tucked in front of their chests, natural thick hind legs planted on snowy valley floor. They are alert rabbits standing to survey the valley, not sitting, not lying, not humans in rabbit suits, not gorilla humanoids. Their heads rise above the roofs of multi-storey mountain castles, enormous hind paws dwarf tiny engineering vehicles, fur catches warm rim light. Both complete rabbit silhouettes clearly legible; heads unobscured. Natural rabbit anatomy and exact owner-photo markings are highest priorities. A modest decorative GPU harness only around shoulders, leaving body fur and shape visible. Warm friendly awe, never threatening.
In LOWER FOREGROUND, observers are smaller but distinct and faces readable, their heads and eyes visibly tilted HIGH UP toward the rabbit faces, astonished and admiring. Left foreground: exactly FIVE separate fluffy BLACK Tufa spider mascots, big expressive white eyes, eight-legged spider bodies (not human Spider-Man characters), looking up together around a newly designed brass GPU scissor-lift wagon. Distinct silhouettes no overlap hiding one. One raises a tiny wrench in wonder. Right foreground: mechanical TURDUCKEN parked on snow with bronze-and-ivory giant turkey body, red snood/wattle, scalloped tail fan, folded articulated wings; open central control bay contains white mechanical CHICKEN with red comb, whose chest contains sunglasses yellow DUCK. Above and around its attached open flight decks, show complete SEVEN approved characters from input3, each looking up at rabbits: muscular bearded tattooed cyber-engineer Mark with gold chain and visor; Son with dense black GPU helmet and broad BLUE visor; round YELLOW black-cap black-hoodie Keith mascot; golden-blonde red-eyed chibi DZ holding pink plush bunny; orange kitten NT in yellow BANANA SUIT with comic blue tears; Choryu with rectangular grayscale cardiac-MRI DISPLAY as head, not human face; silver knight Herminator with tall COBALT-BLUE plume. Exactly TWO little Yorkshire terriers perched securely beside Mark, also looking up. These seven crew must remain recognizable, separate from the nested sunglasses duck, not substituted by generic humans. Keep machine smaller than either rabbit hind paw to emphasize giant scale but close to camera so crew is readable.
Other participants: a few anonymous fully opaque-visored GPU-covered engineers in GREEN-and-BLACK gear on small background carts in the central plaza, all looking skyward; no invented named human likenesses. No ranks, scores or implied race change. Fantasy machinery is metaphor. Dramatic cinematic depth, intricate brass electronics, tactile realistic rabbit fur, snowy mountains and castle city. New scene is the collective upward gaze at STANDING colossal rabbits, not a cableway basin, tram or flying-turkey reprise. Leave small quiet upper-right sky and lower-left snow for later code-drawn overlays. Clean art only, absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, brand logos, labels, watermark or borders.

references.role: Giant scale/style and spider identities only.
Full Turducken crew and nested machine identity only.

review: Inspected native output: two colossal rabbits stand on hind legs, grey-brown lop ears down and dark-and-white companion ears upright with white face blaze. Five distinct black spiders, full seven-character Turducken crew, two Yorkies and anonymous green engineers look upward. New sunrise plaza episode; no text or scores.

editToolArguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is edit TARGET. Image2 is only supporting crew/machine identity reference. Preserve Image1 entirely except three localized cast corrections below. Do NOT change both gigantic STANDING UPRIGHT rabbits, their natural anatomy, fur markings, lop down ears/upright dark ears, scale, poses, light, city, camera, snow, or existing crew identities and upward gaze. This image's standing rabbits are approved.
1. Left foreground currently has SIX fluffy black spiders. Remove ONLY the small middle-back spider directly under the raised wrench spider and immediately to its right, above the central white-eyed front spider. Leave exactly FIVE spiders: leftmost ground spider, raised-wrench spider on scissor lift, the mid-right higher spider beside the rabbits, the central front spider, the rightmost ground spider. Do not add any new spider. Fill the removed little silhouette naturally with background snow/machinery.
2. Turducken crew on right currently lacks Son. ADD ONE unmistakable Son from Image2 at the open forward console on right lower foreground, between Keith black-cap yellow mascot and the chicken's right side. Son has dense black GPU crown/helmet, wide luminous BLUE visor, visible smiling lower face, black-gold cyber-engineer harness. His head tilted up toward giant rabbits, not at viewer. Keep Mark, Keith, DZ with pink plush, banana-kitten NT, MRI-display-headed Choryu and silver/cobalt-plumed knight ALL visible and distinct, as well as exactly two Yorkshire terriers beside Mark. Exactly SEVEN approved crew in total, no duplicates or generic substitutes.
3. Clarify nested Turducken machine in lower right, using Image2 design. Keep its main existing gorgeous metal turkey shape and red wattle/fan. Its open central control bay should visibly contain smaller WHITE mechanical CHICKEN with red comb, whose chest bay contains tiny YELLOW DUCK wearing sunglasses. This duck is distinct from large yellow black-capped Keith. Localized small nested insert, do not obscure any crew or rabbits.
Keep everyone looking UP in friendly awe. No text, numbers, branding or watermark. No other alterations.

generationWorkflow.review: Visually inspected final native output. Exactly five separated fluffy black spiders look up on left. Complete seven-character Turducken crew on right: Mark, Son with blue GPU visor, Keith black cap, DZ pink bunny, banana-kitten NT, MRI-display Choryu, silver/cobalt Herminator; two Yorkies beside Mark. Nested chicken and sunglasses duck now visible inside main mechanical turkey. Anonymous opaque-visored green GPU engineers look upward across plaza. Clear upward gazes, new sunrise plaza composition, no text/scores. Initial output had six spiders and omitted Son; focused edit corrected both and nested machine without altering rabbits. This is commissioned editorial fantasy, not a current roster or score claim.
